items.title: The diagonal of a locally of finite type morphism of algebraic stacks is locally of finite presentation

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the diagonal of a morphism of algebraic stacks locally of finite type is locally of finite presentation, and is of finite presentation when the morphism is in addition quasi-separated (author lemma at source lines 5703-5712, label lemma-diagonal-morphism-finite-type). The proof (source lines 5714-5725) views the diagonal as a morphism over the source, makes the second projection locally of finite type by base-change permanence, concludes the first assertion by the finite-presentation permanence lemma of this chapter, and derives the second from the definition of quasi-separatedness (proof lines 5715-5724). The reformulation over the source and the permanence step are the content. H2.
